enonce.texte:
Vous participez à un débat sur le sujet suivant : 'Technology is making people less intelligent.'

Rédigez un discours d'ouverture (8-10 phrases) pour le POUR ou le CONTRE. Utilisez des discourse markers appropriés.

questions.texte: Rédigez un discours d'ouverture pour le débat.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse pour le CONTRE :

I would argue that technology is actually making us more intelligent. Firstly, access to information has never been easier. We can learn anything we want at any time. Moreover, technology encourages problem-solving and critical thinking. For instance, coding and programming require logical reasoning. Furthermore, educational platforms have made learning more interactive and engaging. However, some may argue that technology makes us lazy. Nevertheless, I believe the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks. In conclusion, technology is a tool that enhances our intelligence when used properly.

sousQuestions.texte: Quel est votre position (pour ou contre) ?
sousQuestions.reponse: Réponse personnelle (pour ou contre)
Exemple : I would argue that, Firstly, Moreover, For instance, Furthermore, However, Nevertheless, In conclusion

enonce.texte:
Lisez l'argument suivant et répondez avec un contre-argument en utilisant des structures de concession et de réfutation.

Argument : 'Online education is not as effective as traditional classroom learning because students lack direct interaction with teachers.'

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

While it is true that online education lacks face-to-face interaction, this does not necessarily mean it is less effective. In fact, online platforms often provide more opportunities for personalized learning. Students can review recorded lectures, access a wider range of resources, and learn at their own pace. Additionally, interactive tools like discussion forums and virtual classrooms can compensate for the lack of physical presence. Therefore, although traditional learning has its advantages, online education can be equally effective, if not more so, in many cases.

sousQuestions.texte: Quelle structure de concession avez-vous utilisée ?
sousQuestions.reponse: While it is true that... / Although...
Online education can be equally effective through personalized learning, access to resources, and interactive tools.

enonce.texte:
Rédigez un essai argumentatif complet (environ 250 mots) sur le sujet suivant :

'The benefits of space exploration outweigh its costs.'

Votre essai doit inclure :

  • Une introduction claire avec une thèse
  • 3 arguments principaux avec des exemples
  • Un contre-argument avec réfutation
  • Une conclusion
  • Des discourse markers variés

questions.texte: Rédigez un essai argumentatif complet sur le sujet donné.
questions.reponse: Exemple de réponse : Introduction Space exploration has always captured the human imagination. However, critics often question whether the enormous costs are justified. In my opinion, the benefits of space exploration significantly outweigh its costs, as it drives technological innovation, expands human knowledge, and offers solutions to global challenges. Body Paragraph 1 Firstly, space exploration drives technological innovation. Many technologies we use today, such as satellite communications, GPS, and medical imaging, originated from space research. Furthermore, the development of reusable rockets has made space travel more affordable, creating new economic opportunities. Body Paragraph 2 Secondly, space exploration expands our understanding of the universe. It allows us to study other planets, search for extraterrestrial life, and understand the origins of our solar system. Moreover, these discoveries inspire future generations to pursue careers in science and engineering. Body Paragraph 3 Thirdly, space exploration offers solutions to global challenges. It helps us monitor climate change, predict natural disasters, and manage resources more efficiently. For instance, satellite data is essential for agriculture, navigation, and environmental protection. Counterargument and Refutation Some may argue that the money spent on space exploration could be used to solve problems on Earth. However, this argument overlooks the fact that space exploration has led to countless innovations that benefit humanity. Additionally, governments allocate only a small fraction of their budgets to space exploration compared to other expenditures. Conclusion In conclusion, while space exploration is expensive, its long-term benefits far outweigh the costs. It drives technological progress, expands human knowledge, and provides solutions to pressing global issues. Therefore, continued investment in space exploration is essential for the future of humanity.

sousQuestions.reponse: The benefits of space exploration significantly outweigh its costs.
1. Technological innovation. 2. Expansion of human knowledge. 3. Solutions to global challenges.
By arguing that space exploration has led to numerous innovations and that the budget allocated is relatively small compared to other expenditures.

enonce.texte:
Vous participez à un débat formel sur le sujet suivant : 'Should university education be free for all students ?'

Rédigez votre intervention complète (12-15 phrases) qui inclut :

  • Une position claire
  • Au moins 3 arguments
  • Des discourse markers variés
  • Une réponse à un contre-argument potentiel

questions.texte: Rédigez votre intervention pour le débat.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse (POUR) :

Honorable judges, ladies and gentlemen, I am here today to argue that university education should be free for all students. 

Firstly, free education promotes equality of opportunity. Regardless of their financial background, every student should have the chance to pursue higher education. Furthermore, a well-educated population benefits the entire economy through higher productivity and innovation.

Secondly, free education reduces the burden of student debt. Many graduates start their careers with enormous loans, which prevents them from making important life decisions like buying a house or starting a family. Consequently, a debt-free education allows young people to contribute more fully to society.

Thirdly, investing in education is an investment in the future. Countries that offer free education, such as Germany and Norway, have seen significant economic growth and social development. Moreover, educated citizens are better equipped to solve complex problems like climate change and social inequality.

Some may argue that free education is too expensive for governments to finance. However, this argument overlooks the long-term returns on investment. The economic benefits of an educated workforce far outweigh the initial costs.

In conclusion, free university education is not only a moral imperative but also a wise investment in our collective future. I urge you to consider the positive impact this policy would have on generations to come.

sousQuestions.reponse: Je suis pour l'éducation universitaire gratuite.
1. Égalité des chances. 2. Réduction de la dette étudiante. 3. Investissement dans l'avenir.
En soulignant que les retours sur investissement à long terme dépassent largement les coûts initiaux.
